name: mac-ui
title: Mac System 7 Kit
description: Mac System 7 inspired window, button, fields (input, textarea, listbox, slider), scroll area, dropdown menu, menubar and feedback components.

files.content:
export { MacWindow, macDither } from './mac-window'
export { MacButton } from './mac-button'
export { MacInput, MacTextarea, MacCheckbox, MacRadio, MacGroup } from './mac-fields'
export { MacScrollArea } from './mac-scroll'
export { MacListbox, type MacListboxOption } from './mac-listbox'
export { MacSlider } from './mac-slider'
export { MacDropdownMenu, type MacMenuItem } from './mac-dropdown'
export { MacMenubar, type MacMenu } from './mac-menubar'
export { MacProgress, MacAlert } from './mac-feedback'

theme.font-rt-mono: var(--font-plex-mono, 'IBM Plex Mono'), ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

.mac-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-button:si.background-image: linear-gradient(to bottom right, transparent 50%, var(--color-mac-ink) 50%), linear-gradient(to bottom left, transparent 50%, var(--color-mac-ink) 50%)
linear-gradient(to top right, transparent 50%, var(--color-mac-ink) 50%), linear-gradient(to top left, transparent 50%, var(--color-mac-ink) 50%)
linear-gradient(to bottom right, transparent 50%, var(--color-mac-ink) 50%), linear-gradient(to top right, transparent 50%, var(--color-mac-ink) 50%)
linear-gradient(to bottom left, transparent 50%, var(--color-mac-ink) 50%), linear-gradient(to top left, transparent 50%, var(--color-mac-ink) 50%)
